parameters.content:
## Try It Out!
### Send payout setup reminder to new Sharetribe providers via Gmail

Automatically send new providers a reminder email to set up their payout details. This ensures providers can receive payments as soon as their first transaction completes.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for new user creation events.
* The Asset Get node retrieves your marketplace's email template text for payout reminders.
* Gmail sends a personalized reminder to the new provider's email address.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Gmail account.
3. Customize the email body with your marketplace's payout setup instructions.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Gmail account

### How to customize
* Add an IF node to only send reminders to providers (filter by user type in publicData).
* Change the delay before sending (add a Wait node).
* Modify the email content with specific payout setup links for your marketplace.
* Replace Gmail with any other email node (Outlook, SMTP, etc.).

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for new users
The Sharetribe Trigger polls your marketplace for `user/created` events. Each new signup triggers this workflow.

## 2. Get email template text
Retrieves your marketplace's payout-related email copy from Sharetribe's Asset Delivery API. Filter is set to "payout" to return only relevant email fields.

## 3. Send payout reminder
Sends the reminder email directly to the new user's email address. The user's email comes from the trigger event data.
